scope: Same-frame texture lighting, cloud detail camera, and optional derived ten-minute fixed-grid brightness-temperature differences over the existing synchronized historical observations.

observations.groundSeriesScope: Existing wind, district rainfall range, sea-level and JMA source records and selection rules retained; no new or recalculated station series intended in this presentation iteration.
observations.finalSourceEqualityVerification: Original v10 synchronized source bundle was byte-identical before delivery; no original source fields or station series changed. Original 72 cloud PNG hashes pass project check.

presentation.reliefMethod: Display-only lighting from spatial gradients in the same source frame; no physical height retrieval, observed shadow or optical-depth estimate.
presentation.detailView: Closer camera framing of the same registered raster; no additional source resolution.
presentation.rawMode: Same unfused brightness-temperature display frame; relief and change overlay disabled.

derivedChange.formula: currentUint16 * 0.01 - previousUint16 * 0.01, with signed subtraction in the offline implementation
derivedChange.inputData: Retained wide-v10 uint16 brightness-temperature rasters, not the quantized 8-bit display PNGs.
derivedChange.selection: Exact UTC instant; no nearest frame and no comparison across the missing scan.
derivedChange.bundleContract: All valid source pairs must exist, with matching source numeric hashes, grid, dimensions and exactly 600 seconds between nominal times.
derivedChange.meaning: Change at fixed geographic grid cells, not the temperature tendency of a tracked cloud parcel, wind, cloud velocity or rainfall.

playbackImplementation.preparation: Prepare the next real cloud frame and, if enabled, its change image before selecting the shared clock.
playbackImplementation.cacheCommit: Cloud binds synchronously from cache; change waits for the same cloud-ready promise, then binds within microtasks before the next render. Slow cloud loading clears prior changes immediately.
playbackImplementation.invalidation: Manual selection, toggles, mode changes and clear/dispose invalidate superseded selections; late image callbacks cannot restore old pairs.
playbackImplementation.failure: Missing pair and loading failure have explicit states; no old overlay is presented as the new pair.
playbackImplementation.finalIntegrationValidation: 13 controlled asynchronous regression tests invoke actual app functions; passed.

validation.rasterValidation: All 70 pairs, 72 numeric inputs, every displayed pixel and independent alpha formula verified; see change-v11/validation-report.json.

checksPassed: Actual GPU rendering of same-frame relief, near camera and derived change overlay.
Relief toggle preserves 13:00 clock and original 111.12 km/h, 2–48 mm, 3.7 m observations.
12:50–13:00 change overlay and selected clock match.
08:00 has no prior pair; 10:40 has no current cloud; 10:50 retains cloud without a pair; 11:00 restores valid change.
Raw mode disables both enhancements without changing selected time.
2x full playback reaches 20:00 and stops with 19:50–20:00 change and all four chart clocks at 20:00.
Full path A/B and principle modes remain accessible; change and detail controls hide when irrelevant.
Downloaded JSON retains selected/rendered cloud/pair time, formula, source hashes and actual station definitions.
390px mobile has no horizontal overflow; controls remain within viewport.
browser.locations: D staging full playback/missing-scan/export checks; delivered E original for desktop/mobile, modes, relief, change, raw and console. Delivered files were byte-verified.
browser.loadingRaceTests: Node VM with controlled promises, not browser network throttling.
browser.finalState: E localhost4175, 13:00 paused, fusion+relief enabled, change disabled, regional camera, default viewport restored.
browser.performanceScope: Real browser rendering verified; no quantitative low-end hardware benchmark.

boundaries: Lighting is a display aid from the same-frame texture, not observed cloud height, shadow, optical depth or a reconstructed 3D volume.
Fixed-grid brightness-temperature differences can include feature displacement, temperature and observation/navigation effects; the cause is not inferred.
The 265 K selection and 4–12 K opacity ramp are display choices, not cloud classification or confidence measures.
Nominal ten-minute pairs are scans spanning minutes, not two instantaneous exposures; parallax remains uncorrected.
Source uint16 precision is a storage convention, not a claim of 0.01 K measurement accuracy.
